context.transcript:
Hello, welcome to Men's Photography Studio.
Thanks.
You must be new to the area.
I just noticed your sign outside.
Yes, I opened this shop about a month ago.
Well, my name's Olivia Sanchez.
I'm the president of the Claiborne Small Business Association.
I stopped by to see if you'd be interested in joining our organization.
We're local business owners who meet monthly to share information and network.
That sounds interesting, but I'm not familiar with your group.
I'd like to know more before making a decision.
Sure.
You should check out our website at claybornsba. com.
It has a calendar that shows all of our upcoming events.

您好，欢迎来到 Men's Photography Studio。
谢谢。

是的，我大约一个月前开的这家店。

我是 Claiborne Small Business Association 的总裁。
我路过这里想看看您是否有兴趣加入我们的组织。
我们是当地的企业主，每月聚会分享信息和建立人脉网络。
听起来很有趣，但我对你们的团体不太了解。
我想在做决定之前了解更多一些。
当然。
你应该查看我们在 claybornsba. com 的网站。
上面有一个日历，显示了我们所有即将举行的活动。
